import random, sys, time, importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("main", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
main = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(main)
POW3=main.POW3
rng=random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0)

def build(m, k, nf=1, vmax=1000000):
    adj={i:set() for i in range(m)}
    later=[[] for _ in range(m)]
    for i in range(m-1,-1,-1):
        cand=[x for x in range(i+1,m)]; rng.shuffle(cand)
        chosen=[]
        for c in cand:
            if all(c in adj[x] for x in chosen):
                chosen.append(c)
                if len(chosen)==k: break
        later[i]=chosen
        for c in chosen: adj[i].add(c); adj[c].add(i)
    factors=[]
    for i in range(m):
        pool=[i]+later[i]
        for _ in range(nf):
            extra=[x for x in pool if x!=i and rng.random()<0.95]
            scope=tuple(sorted([i]+extra))
            size=POW3[len(scope)]
            tab=[rng.randint(1,vmax) if rng.random()>0.02 else 0 for _ in range(size)]
            factors.append((scope,tab))
    return factors, list(range(m))

for m,k,nf in ((64,4,1),(64,4,2),(32,4,2),(64,4,1)):
    factors, order = build(m,k,nf)
    red=main.reduce_factors(factors)
    print("m",m,"k",k,"nf",nf,"factors",len(factors),"scopes",sorted(set(len(s) for s,_ in factors)))
    t0=time.perf_counter(); Z,marg=main.infer_joint(red,order,m); t1=time.perf_counter()
    print("  Z bits",Z.bit_length(),"jt %.3fs"%(t1-t0), "sumcheck", all(sum(marg[v])==Z for v in range(m)))
    t2=time.perf_counter(); Zn=main.partition_value(red,order); t3=time.perf_counter()
    print("  plain elim %.3fs"%(t3-t2), Zn==Z)
